claim_boundary: This is a bounded live multi-agent LLM pilot over reviewed ATCSCC samples. It exercises extractor, deterministic validator, live critic, and live refiner roles under hard ontology/evidence gates. It is not a full 100-record formal run and must not be cited as operational decision support.

agent_roles.input: ATCSCC source text plus ATMONTO ATCSCC profile menu
agent_roles.output: candidate flat KG facts with copied evidence spans

agent_roles.input: extractor facts, source text, and schema slice
agent_roles.operation: deterministic schema, datatype/range, and evidence validation
agent_roles.output: S5 validator-accepted facts and validator rejections

agent_roles.input: S5 facts, CQ routes, validator rejections, and source text
agent_roles.operation: live LLM critique with deterministic duplicate/text-artifact safeguards
live LLM final payload rewrite under no-new-facts safety gate
agent_roles.output: S6 facts retained after final deterministic validation

examples.evidence_text: ATCSCC ADVZY 069 LAS/ZLA 05/18/2026 LAS AIRPORT ARRIVAL DELAYS
reasons: live_critic:Duplicate/overlapping initiativeComments with fact-06; evidence span is just the title line and the extracted value is weaker than the fuller supported comment in fact-06.

sota_interpretation.what_is_satisfied: The project now has a bounded live LLM multi-agent S5/S6 pilot that uses the same ATMONTO profile, evidence gates, and scoring layer as the deterministic run.
sota_interpretation.remaining_gap: The live pilot is intentionally small. A full SOTA claim would require a full 100-record live run, cost/latency accounting, and human review of the answer layer.
sota_interpretation.claim_use: Use this artifact as live-pilot evidence for the method design, not as proof that autonomous agents outperform the deterministic extractor.
